text:
No option can be put forward yet: the £400k annual-salary limit was not checkable in this run.

- All four options were analysed as having no stated effect on annual salary spend, so the budget constraint was excluded rather than tested.
- The comparison is fragile, and every substantive estimate is machine-authored; none has been validated by you.
- Incremental delivery capacity and onboarding load materially shape the result, but their exact effects remain estimates.

The model needs annual salary spend stated for each staffing option, in £/year, before it can assess the budget condition.
